description: Dear Neighbor,I hope this email finds you well. It’s been another productive month, both here in Onslow County and in Raleigh, as I’ve stayed focused on the work you sent me to do — standing up for our military families, supporting our schools, and making sure our community’s voice is heard.Whether it’s meeting with constituents, working through legislation, or preparing for the upcoming legislative short session, my priority remains delivering real results for the people I represent.As always,
title: The Onslow Observer: Supporting Veterans, Upcoming Town Hall, & More...
